collection.name: A PIECE OF ME BY IFXSCRIPT
collection.description:
"A Piece of Me" is a deeply personal generative art project born from a period of profound grief and eventual healing. Created during my mother's courageous battle with cancer, and in the aftermath of her passing, each unique geometric composition reflects moments of survival, memory, and the intricate journey of processing loss.

Through algorithmic creation, every inscription ID seeds a distinct visual narrative, capturing the complex emotions experienced during a time of immense pressure and sorrow. The evolving forms and chosen palettes subtly echo the echoes of a life lived, the strength found in adversity, and the quiet beauty of remembrance. This project is a testament to art's power to transform pain into a space for reflection and solace
